pondfill: A person squats down low at the edge of a pond, leans forward and holds a bucket by its rim with both hands, pushes the bucket down into the water in front of his feet, holds it under for a moment, then lifts the heavy full bucket out with both hands and slowly stands up straight, leaning back slightly from the weight.
washface: A person squats down at the edge of a pond, scoops water with both cupped hands, splashes it onto his face, scoops again and rubs his face, then shakes the water off his hands.
walknat: A man walks forward at a relaxed natural pace on flat ground, arms swinging loosely, shoulders relaxed, slight natural bounce in each step, looking ahead.
